create_CubeRotateZAxis: create a CubeRotateZAxis environment instance with default config for z-axis cube rotation task
run_domain_randomize: run domain randomization on an mjx model with randomized friction, mass, and damping parameters
get_default_config: get the default config dict with control dt, action scale, noise, and reward settings for rotate-z task
reset_CubeRotateZAxis: reset the CubeRotateZAxis environment with randomized hand and cube initial states
step_CubeRotateZAxis: step the CubeRotateZAxis environment with motor target actions and return updated state with rewards
